rec.name: Cart Stock Availability Meter
rec.status: Built — cart/cart drawer only; PDP version split into a separate ticket

what.text: A compact stock-availability bar shown under each cart line item (cart drawer and cart page). It shows the remaining stock of the variant as text (e.g. "Noch 8 auf Lager") plus a progress bar whose fill is the share of remaining stock relative to an 'original quantity'. Two layouts exist: Default (a pill with text on the left and a thin bar on the right) and Classic (a boxed card with the title 'Verfügbarkeit', the subtitle 'Nur solange der Vorrat reicht!' and a bar with the text 'Nur noch X% verfügbar' inside it). It only renders for variants with Shopify-tracked inventory and stock > 0.

why.text: Scarcity and loss aversion: a visibly shrinking bar and a concrete 'only X left' message make the buyer feel the product could sell out. This nudges them to complete checkout instead of postponing. Showing it at the cart stage reinforces the decision just before purchase. The visual bar is processed faster than text alone.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet `ed_cro_stock_availability`. It reads `variant.inventory_quantity` and the variant metafield `standard.cro_original_quantity` (falls back to 100 if empty), computes percent = stock*100/original (capped at 100), and renders the Default or Classic markup. It only renders if stock > 0 and `inventory_management == 'shopify'`. 2) Paste a settings block into `config/settings_schema.json` (checkbox, colors, layout select, text fields). 3) Create the variant metafield 'CRO | Original Quantity' (integer, min 0). 4) Add `{% render 'ed_cro_stock_availability', line_item: line_item %}`, wrapped in `settings.show_cro_stock_availability`, inside the line-item loop of the cart drawer and cart page files. 5) Customize in the Theme Editor and test on desktop and mobile. On mobile the Default layout wraps, so the bar sits full-width below the text. Numbers from 1,000 to 9,999 are formatted with a comma separator.

items: Default layout: text before stock (default "Noch") and text after stock (default "auf Lager"), as inline richtext so bold/italic/underline are possible
Classic layout: title, subtitle, text before and after the percentage (inline richtext)
Per variant: 'CRO | Original Quantity' metafield defines the reference quantity (100% bar length)

dependencies.text: Variant metafield `standard.cro_original_quantity` (Integer). Variant inventory tracked by Shopify (`inventory_management == 'shopify'`). Edit access to the code (new snippet, `config/settings_schema.json`, and the cart/cart-drawer line-item loop). Settings are global theme settings, not a section, because the snippet runs inside the cart loop where section settings are not available. The original ticket asked for a standalone section with separate font size, bold and underline settings, but the build uses theme settings and richtext. Not built for the PDP: variant switching would need extra JS and a separate layout, so a new ticket was agreed.

items: Share of orders with low-stock items
